source_file: Step 7.Variable Derivation for Case-Control and Cohort Analyses.sas
notes: Cohort-side 'Define derived variables' block (sub7_2 -> sub7_3): builds the immortal-time-bias censoring date as min(GDM date, death date, 31DEC2022), derives survival time from two index points (LMP-based and 24-weeks-gestation-based), and flags whether the GDM event falls inside each window. Reproduced verbatim except for the LIBNAME source, replaced with a 6-row mock cohort shaped like sub.sub6_v6_cohort. age_ga24 was recomputed from age/birthday directly since BIRTH_YM_M (a Step-1-only field) isn't present in the mock; the array-based min-date censoring, event flags and ga_gdm grouping are untouched from the original.
